selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent spatial exploration chain. First, the player must locate light_blue_glazed_terracotta, which serves as a distinctive visual landmark marking a bedroom structure. Once found, the player navigates to the bedroom where a light_blue_bed is placed — the glazed terracotta acts as a decorative element identifying this specific room. After mining the bed, the player discovers and drinks a potion placed on a nightstand or nearby table in the same room. This creates a natural find → mine → use progression that tests navigation, block interaction, and item consumption.

edges.reason: The light_blue_glazed_terracotta marks the bedroom entrance; player must find it to locate the light_blue_bed inside
Mining the bed reveals/grants access to the potion placed behind or beneath the bed area in the bedroom

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near and face the light_blue_glazed_terracotta pillars at the building entrance. Target is the right pillar at spawn-relative (10, 1, 3), which is ~10 blocks from spawn and requires intentional navigation to the entrance side. Max distance 5 with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has actually approached and is looking at the terracotta rather than trivially satisfying from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as an item into the player's inventory. The light_blue_bed is inside the bedroom at spawn-relative (8-9, 0, 8). Since the player starts with no light_blue_bed in inventory, having one confirms the bed was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks where the drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has with glass_bottle because drinking a potion in Minecraft consumes the potion and leaves an empty glass_bottle in the player's inventory. Since the player starts with no glass_bottle, detecting one confirms a potion was drunk. The healing potion is an item entity near the nightstand at spawn-relative (10, 2, 8) — player must pick it up, equip it, and use it to drink.

scene_description: A compact bedroom building on a stone_bricks floor. The building is made of oak_planks with a wide 5-block entrance flanked by two tall light_blue_glazed_terracotta pillars (4 blocks high each). Inside, a light_blue_bed faces west with a nightstand (oak_stairs + brewing_stand) beside it, on which a healing potion item entity sits. The player spawns with an iron_pickaxe facing the building.
task_text: Find the light blue glazed terracotta pillars marking the bedroom entrance, go inside and mine the light blue bed, then pick up and drink the healing potion from the nightstand.
design_notes: Building at ~3-11,0-4,~3-11 (9x9 footprint). Entrance wall at z=3 with 5-block-wide doorway (x=5-9) flanked by glazed terracotta pillars at x=4 and x=10. Bed at (8-9, 0, 8) facing west. Nightstand at (10, 0-1, 8) with brewing stand holding potion entity at (10, 2, 8). Player spawns at origin with iron_pickaxe. Stone_bricks floor extends 10 blocks in all directions for clean navigation.
